objective: Review commit 6c86fe3 on release/0.3.0/fix/pi-windows-launch, which pins the platform and path module of the Pi extension and contract tests so they pass on windows-latest, for lost coverage or weakened assertions.
scope: The windows CI job failed 103 Pi tests because the harness left the platform unset; the fix passes platform linux and the posix path module wherever stubs are POSIX-shaped, and keeps explicit win32 tests.

Check: every behaviour the tests asserted before is still asserted; the Windows launch paths (bun.exe, bun.cmd via cmd.exe, driveless entries, powershell) stay covered by explicit win32 tests; nothing now depends on the runner's real platform in a way that hides a Windows-only product defect.
constraints: Read-only; you may run bun test on the two files in that worktree.

criteria.text: The review states whether any assertion was weakened or any covered behaviour lost, with path:line
The review states whether the Windows launch behaviour remains covered by explicit win32 tests
